earnings.title: ADM Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Reports third quarter 2026 EPS 2 of $1.70 and adjusted EPS 1,2 of $1.77
EPS 2 of $1.70, with adjusted EPS 1,2 of $1.77
EPS 2 on a GAAP basis was $1.70, representing an increase of $1.48 compared to the prior year quarter EPS of $0.22.
Adjusted EPS 1,2 was $1.77, an increase of $0.85 compared to the prior year quarter of $0.92.
EPS 2 on a GAAP basis was $4.18, up $2.89 versus the prior year period, and adjusted EPS 1,2 was $4.33, up $1.77 versus the prior year period.

quotes.text: ADM delivered strong third quarter results, with earnings up significantly from the prior year quarter and operating profit growth across all segments.
quotes.by: Juan Luciano, Chair of the Board and Chief Executive Officer

outlook: ADM now expects 2026 adjusted EPS 1,2 of approximately $5.50 to $5.80, up from the prior adjusted EPS guidance range of $5.15 to $5.60

items.heading: The Company is exposed to potential business disruption risks which could adversely affect the Company’s operating results and could result in increased expenses and liabilities.
Transportation, inflationary impacts, and fluctuations in energy prices could affect the Company’s operating results.
Human capital availability may not be sufficient to effectively support global operations.
The Company may fail to realize the benefits of or experience delays in the execution of its strategic priorities.

The Company has limited control over, may not realize the expected benefits of, and may be required to write down, its equity investments and joint ventures, and may not be able to monetize the investments at an attractive value when the Company decides to exit the investments.
The Company faces risks related to health epidemics, pandemics, and similar outbreaks.
